We have. What we do is calculate compatibility votes between your votes and the ones of senators and representatives (+ a whole lot of other data, like votes based on district, state,..) I will give you a quick example. Lets say that I am from Texas and one of my senators is John Cornyn. I voted on 11 bills that have been voted by him aswell. These votes will be compared to his votes and I will start building my compatibility rating based on these. If I agree with him and vote similarly my compatibility will be very high - means that from my point of view he is doing a great job. If he has a low compatibility rating it means I probably shouldn't re-elect him. Example screenshot: http://i.imgur.com/bEcYIjm.png

In the same way these compatibility votes are calculated for every representative and senator in congress for each user, state, district and so on. I would say this is our strongest point as you get instant feedback on how the members of congress are doing. So far we are the only site that does this.
